subject: Post-demo security recap & request: SOC 2 Type II, bridge letter, trust portal access
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodai.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@medalytix.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodai.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2026-09-18T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo security recap & request: SOC 2 Type II, bridge letter, trust portal access

Hi Sara — thanks again for the demo earlier today. Quick recap from our side and a proposed security intake path so we can keep procurement moving: 

- Discovery highlights: Medalytix plans to evaluate Redwood for inference serving across your analytics pipelines (low-latency inference for clinical scoring). You confirmed HIPAA scope for PHI processing and EU traffic for a subset of customers (GDPR considerations).

- Ask from your side: you wanted estimated SLOs and deployment options (we'll follow up separately with the perf profile). From our side we need the standard security artifacts to progress the commercial review: SOC 2 Type II report (most recent period), a signed bridge letter/temporary attestation if available, and completion of our vendor security questionnaire (we call it the VSQ/DDQ).

Next steps I propose: 
1) If you can share the SOC 2 Type II (PDF) and any bridge letter, please upload to our Trust Portal invite (I can send): this is the preferred path.
2) If you prefer SFTP or an auditor portal, let us know — we can provide a temporary S3 upload link.
3) Start the VSQ we shared in the link below (it takes ~30 minutes for basic answers).
4) For legal/data processing: if you have a standard DPA we can review, please attach; otherwise we can circulate the Redwood DPA (DocuSign).

I attached our bridge letter template to help speed things up. Ben (cc) on security will coordinate the intake and portal access. Can you confirm who at Medalytix will own the upload (security or procurement) and whether there are any NDA requirements before sharing the SOC 2?

Thanks — we want to keep this tight so we can get to procurement in the next 2–3 weeks.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Sales (West)
Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: redwood-bridge-letter-template.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@medalytix.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2026-09-18T17:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo security recap & request: SOC 2 Type II, bridge letter, trust portal access

On Fri, Sep 18, 2026 at 3:10 PM Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodai.com> wrote:
> Hi Sara — thanks again for the demo earlier today. Quick recap from our side and a proposed security intake path so we can keep procurement moving: 
> ...

Thanks Kimberly — great session. I'll own the procurement side and will loop in our security lead for the technical artifacts. Quick answers: 
- Security owner for uploads: Michael Chen (michael.chen@medalytix.com), Head of InfoSec. He will handle SOC 2 and the DDQ.
- SOC 2 status: we have a SOC 2 Type II for the period ending 2026-06-30; auditor is NorthPoint LLP. We can share the report but prefer to upload to a secure portal rather than email.
- HIPAA/GDPR: we operate under HIPAA for US PHI and have GDPR controls; we may need clarification on data residency for EU traffic but that's manageable.
- NDA: procurement typically requires a mutual NDA before sharing full reports with external vendors, but if the portal supports access controls and IP-restricted invites that's usually sufficient.

I attached a short cover page for the SOC 2 that lists scope and auditor. Michael will be on the thread to confirm portal intake and timing. Expect him to reply later today.

Sara Patel
Director of Procurement
Medalytix
---
Attachment: medalytix-soc2-cover.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodai.com>
To: Michael Chen <michael.chen@medalytix.com>, Sara Patel <sara.patel@medalytix.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodai.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2026-09-18T18:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo security recap & request: SOC 2 Type II, bridge letter, trust portal access

Hi Michael / Sara — Ben here from Redwood Security. Thanks for the quick turnaround, Sara. 

To make this as frictionless as possible: 
- I'll send a Trust Portal invite today to michael.chen@medalytix.com with object-level access (view/download) and a 30-day expiry. Portal link: https://trust.redwood.ai/invite/x7f3-portal (one-time token).
- If you prefer not to use a portal, we can create a short-lived S3 upload link (we use this for large auditor bundles).
- Attached is a signed bridge letter PDF (non-binding interim attestation) you can use while we complete contractual items. Please note the bridge letter references Redwood's SOC 2 for the period listed — if your legal team requires a bilateral NDA we can also arrange one.
- We also have a short VSQ (vendor security questionnaire) — basic answers are sufficient for procurement; the full DDQ is optional. Please complete the VSQ here: https://redwoodai.app/dsq/medalytix-basic
- For DPA: our standard DPA is live in DocuSign if you'd like to sign now: https://app.docusign.com/templates/REDWOOD-DPA-2026. If Medalytix needs redlines, send them to legal@redwoodai.com and we'll triage.

Action items: 
- Michael: accept portal invite and upload SOC 2 PDF + any supporting evidence (control matrix, if available).
- Sara: confirm whether procurement wants a mutual NDA prior to portal access.
- Kimberly / Aditya: I'll flag any scope questions after I review the report (likely within 48 hours).

Thanks — I'll get the portal email out in the next 20 minutes.

Ben Carter
Security Ops Lead
Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: bridge-letter-redwood_signed.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Michael Chen <michael.chen@medalytix.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodai.com>, Sara Patel <sara.patel@medalytix.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2026-09-19T09:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo security recap & request: SOC 2 Type II, bridge letter, trust portal access

Thanks Ben — invite received and accepted this morning (portal account created). I'll begin the upload today and have the SOC 2 bundle + control summary in the portal by end of day PDT. A few items for clarity: 
- Auditor & scope: NorthPoint LLP; scope includes hosting, data processing, and change management for our inference stack (exclusions noted on cover).
- Data residency: we prefer US-west for production; we'll note EU traffic for specific customers and will want contract language around that.
- VSQ: I'll start the basic VSQ and flag any technical items that need clarification from your engineering team.
- DPA: procurement prefers Redwood's DocuSign DPA — Sara, can you confirm whether we should sign now or wait for negotiated clauses?

If you need a point of contact for privileged access to logs or temporaries, that's me (michael.chen@medalytix.com). Thanks for making the portal path easy — should speed up the review.

Michael Chen
Head of Information Security
Medalytix
